summary: Enhance your NGO's impact with our Data-Driven Project Management training course. Learn to leverage data for effective decision-making and project success.
lede: Data-driven project management for NGOs helps teams use evidence to make stronger decisions, manage limited resources, and work toward measurable outcomes. You’ll learn how data can support projects that serve communities while balancing diverse stakeholder needs and accountability expectations. The course covers data collection, analysis, and visualization, then applies these skills to planning, monitoring, and evaluation. Through practical exercises and real-world examples, you’ll explore how to track progress, guide strategy, and communicate results to donors and beneficiaries.
audienceIntro: This training is tailored for NGO professionals who manage, design, or oversee projects and want to incorporate data-driven methodologies into their work.
audience: Program and project managers in the NGO
modules: Driving Innovation in NGO Projects with Data
Advanced Tools and Technologies for Data Management
Implementing a Data-Driven Culture in NGOs
